data.title: web: Bun server startHubWeb, routes table, 127.0.0.1 bind

data.text:
web: implemented startHubWeb + routes table + 127.0.0.1 bind (commit fad372e).

Files:
- web/src/server.ts: startHubWeb(deps) - Bun.serve hostname 127.0.0.1 only (non-configurable v1), port default 7749; bus subscribe on start, unsubscribe + close all SSE conns on stop(); API writes dispatch through injected CommandSurface (answer/assign/send/attention-dismiss ops, by web); no CORS, no auth (v1 tradeoff per docs/04)
- web/src/routes/table.ts: full route table - HTML GET / /session/:id /agent /archive /archive/:id (placeholders, CSP, 404 page listing open sessions for unknown id); POST /api/answer|assign|send|dismiss (JSON in/out, 400 malformed/missing fields, HubError to HTTP map: unknown-session 404, denied 409); GET /api/status (snapshot payload); GET /stream SSE stub with initial snapshot event, conns tracked for stop(); 405 + Allow on method mismatch; 404 unknown paths
- web/src/snapshot.ts: buildSnapshot {v, digest, attention, sessions} - resolved items filtered, closed sessions excluded; agent digest or synthesized counts line
- web/src/html.ts: placeholder renderers themed from lib TOKEN_HEX (no hardcoded hex), v1 CSP
- web/src/types.ts: HubWebDeps / SessionDigest / SnapshotPayload / SseConn / HubWebLogs port shapes
- web/src/server.test.ts: 21 tests, fetch against 127.0.0.1 with temp data root (never real hub dir)
- tsconfig.json: include web + cli (workspace-wide tsc)

Decisions:
- dismiss goes as cmd frame attention {action dismiss, id} per docs/03 board d-key decision (no dismiss op in locked op list)
- send args {target, text}, assign {id, task} per docs/03 cmd frames
- SessionDigest = {id, session: SessionRecord} - minimal interpretation of spec SessionDigest[]; snapshot shape shared by /api/status and snapshot SSE event
- /stream: snapshot-only stub (spec-sanctioned); full delta fan-out is tk-szb
- bind verified by IPv6 ::1 fetch failing + loopback succeeding

Test output: bun test 113 pass / 0 fail (21 web); bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0 workspace-wide. server.stop() verified to release port (rebind same port succeeds).
